title: SS27 Boys' Category Opportunities
summary: Boyswear growth for SS27: denim, refined sport, UV swim, polos and sets.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Sport influence was presented "through a more refined, creative lens"; denim felt "stronger and more diverse than in recent seasons"<sup>[1]</sup>
- Swimwear, T-shirts and accessories with built-in UV filters were prominent and are becoming common, linked to family concern for health and to changing climate<sup>[2]</sup>
- Cozmo showed striped T-shirts and coordinated sets forming a total look, for newborns to 14 years<sup>[3]</sup>
- True Artist makes unisex outfits for children and pre-teens<sup>[4]</sup>

sections.heading: Opportunities
sections.body:
1. Denim shorts, overalls and jackets.
2. Track sets and polos.
3. UV tees and swim.
4. Coordinated sets.
5. Unisex basics that serve boys and girls.

design_implications:
- Prioritise function and durability.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Re-weight buys to denim and sport.
